representation.name: CD14 protein-coding gene length vs mean expression Pearson correlation
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.counts_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.gene_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" <<'PY'
import csv
import sys
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

counts_path, gene_metadata_path, sample_metadata_path = sys.argv[1:4]

selected_samples = []
with open(sample_metadata_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
        if row.get("celltype") == "CD14":
            selected_samples.append(row.get("sample"))
if not selected_samples or any(x is None or x == "" for x in selected_samples):
    raise ValueError("No valid CD14 sample names were found")
if len(selected_samples) != len(set(selected_samples)):
    raise ValueError("Duplicate CD14 sample names in sample metadata")

gene_info = {}
with open(gene_metadata_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row.get("")
        if not gene_id:
            gene_id = row.get("Geneid")
        if not gene_id:
            raise ValueError("Gene metadata row has no gene identifier")
        if gene_id in gene_info:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate gene identifier in gene metadata: " + gene_id)
        if row.get("gene_biotype") == "protein_coding":
            gene_info[gene_id] = int(row["Length"])

lengths = []
means = []
rows_seen = 0
rows_retained = 0
with open(counts_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    reader = csv.reader(fh)
    header = next(reader)
    if len(header) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Counts matrix has no sample columns")
    positions = []
    for sample in selected_samples:
        try:
            positions.append(header.index(sample))
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError("CD14 sample absent from counts matrix: " + sample)
    if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate sample columns selected from counts matrix")
    for row in reader:
        rows_seen += 1
        if len(row) != len(header):
            raise ValueError("Counts row has a different number of columns at row {}".format(rows_seen + 1))
        gene_id = row[0]
        info = gene_info.get(gene_id)
        if info is None:
            continue
        values = [float(row[pos]) for pos in positions]
        total = sum(values)
        if total >= 10:
            rows_retained += 1
            lengths.append(float(info))
            means.append(total / float(len(values)))

if len(lengths) < 3:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than three genes passed the requested filters")
r_value = pearsonr(lengths, means)[0]

with open("correlation.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("metric\tvalue\tcelltype\tselected_samples\tgene_biotype\ttotal_count_threshold\tgenes_retained\tcounts_rows_seen\n")
    out.write("pearson_r\t{:.17g}\tCD14\t{}\tprotein_coding\t10\t{}\t{}\n".format(
        float(r_value), len(selected_samples), rows_retained, rows_seen))
PY

representation.name: CD14 protein-coding gene length vs mean expression Pearson correlation (R)
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript --vanilla -e 'stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(stats::cor(c(1, 2), c(1, 2)), 1)))'
Rscript --vanilla - "$(inputs.counts_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.gene_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop("Expected counts, gene metadata, and sample metadata paths")
counts_path <- args[[1]]
gene_metadata_path <- args[[2]]
sample_metadata_path <- args[[3]]

sample_metadata <- read.csv(sample_metadata_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cd14_samples <- sample_metadata$sample[sample_metadata$celltype == "CD14"]
if (length(cd14_samples) == 0L || any(is.na(cd14_samples)) || any(cd14_samples == "")) stop("No valid CD14 sample names")
if (anyDuplicated(cd14_samples)) stop("Duplicate CD14 sample names")

gene_metadata <- read.csv(gene_metadata_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_metadata_ids <- gene_metadata[[1L]]
if (anyDuplicated(gene_metadata_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers in gene metadata")

counts <- read.csv(counts_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
count_ids <- counts[[1L]]
sample_names <- names(counts)[-1L]
positions <- match(cd14_samples, sample_names)
if (anyNA(positions)) stop("A CD14 sample is absent from the counts matrix")
if (anyDuplicated(positions)) stop("Duplicate CD14 columns selected")

cd14_counts <- counts[, positions + 1L, drop = FALSE]
if (!all(vapply(cd14_counts, is.numeric, logical(1)))) stop("Selected count columns are not numeric")
total_counts <- rowSums(as.matrix(cd14_counts))
mean_expression <- total_counts / length(positions)

metadata_position <- match(count_ids, gene_metadata_ids)
if (anyNA(metadata_position)) stop("A count-matrix gene is absent from gene metadata")
biotype <- gene_metadata$gene_biotype[metadata_position]
gene_length <- as.numeric(gene_metadata$Length[metadata_position])
keep <- biotype == "protein_coding" & total_counts >= 10 & !is.na(gene_length) & !is.na(mean_expression)
if (sum(keep) < 3L) stop("Fewer than three genes passed the requested filters")

r_value <- stats::cor(gene_length[keep], mean_expression[keep], method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")

result <- data.frame(
  metric = "pearson_r",
  value = sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(r_value)),
  celltype = "CD14",
  selected_samples = length(positions),
  gene_biotype = "protein_coding",
  total_count_threshold = 10,
  genes_retained = sum(keep),
  counts_rows_seen = nrow(counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = "correlation.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RS

import csv
import sys
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

counts_path, gene_metadata_path, sample_metadata_path = sys.argv[1:4]

selected_samples = []
with open(sample_metadata_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
        if row.get("celltype") == "CD14":
            selected_samples.append(row.get("sample"))
if not selected_samples or any(x is None or x == "" for x in selected_samples):
    raise ValueError("No valid CD14 sample names were found")
if len(selected_samples) != len(set(selected_samples)):
    raise ValueError("Duplicate CD14 sample names in sample metadata")

gene_info = {}
with open(gene_metadata_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
    for row in reader:
        gene_id = row.get("")
        if not gene_id:
            gene_id = row.get("Geneid")
        if not gene_id:
            raise ValueError("Gene metadata row has no gene identifier")
        if gene_id in gene_info:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate gene identifier in gene metadata: " + gene_id)
        if row.get("gene_biotype") == "protein_coding":
            gene_info[gene_id] = int(row["Length"])

lengths = []
means = []
rows_seen = 0
rows_retained = 0
with open(counts_path, "r", newline="") as fh:
    reader = csv.reader(fh)
    header = next(reader)
    if len(header) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Counts matrix has no sample columns")
    positions = []
    for sample in selected_samples:
        try:
            positions.append(header.index(sample))
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError("CD14 sample absent from counts matrix: " + sample)
    if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate sample columns selected from counts matrix")
    for row in reader:
        rows_seen += 1
        if len(row) != len(header):
            raise ValueError("Counts row has a different number of columns at row {}".format(rows_seen + 1))
        gene_id = row[0]
        info = gene_info.get(gene_id)
        if info is None:
            continue
        values = [float(row[pos]) for pos in positions]
        total = sum(values)
        if total >= 10:
            rows_retained += 1
            lengths.append(float(info))
            means.append(total / float(len(values)))

if len(lengths) < 3:
    raise ValueError("Fewer than three genes passed the requested filters")
r_value = pearsonr(lengths, means)[0]

with open("correlation.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("metric\tvalue\tcelltype\tselected_samples\tgene_biotype\ttotal_count_threshold\tgenes_retained\tcounts_rows_seen\n")
    out.write("pearson_r\t{:.17g}\tCD14\t{}\tprotein_coding\t10\t{}\t{}\n".format(
        float(r_value), len(selected_samples), rows_retained, rows_seen))
